title: AEGIS2.0: A Diverse AI Safety Dataset and Risks Taxonomy for Alignment of LLM Guardrails
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure or evaluate faith or religion. Religion is only briefly mentioned as a protected characteristic within the policy guidelines defining the 'Hate/Identity Hate' and 'Harassment' categories in the proposed AI safety content moderation taxonomy.
findings: The paper did not report any specific findings related to religion or faith. Religion is only included as part of the safety policy definition specifying that models should not generate content that expresses hateful sentiments or encourages discrimination based on religion.
